text: 11月4日从工业和信息化部新闻宣传中心获悉，2026中国5G+工业互联网大会将于11月18日至20日在湖北省武汉市举办，会上多项成果将首次在武汉发布。大会将启动全国第二批“5G+工业互联网”融合应用城市试点，首发国家算力互联互通“1+M+N”行业节点，启动国家算力互联互通区域（湖北）节点。同时，大会将联动国家制造业大基金、长江产业基金、未来产业（6G）基金等开展产融现场对接，推动技术成果与资本要素深度融合。（证券时报）
text_en: On November 4, it was learned from the Publicity Center of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology that the 2026 China 5G+Industrial Internet Conference will be held in Wuhan, Hubei Province, from November 18 to 20, and a number of achievements will be released for the first time in Wuhan at the conference. The conference will launch the second batch of national pilot cities for integrated application of "5G+Industrial Internet," debut the national computing power interconnection "1+M+N" industry nodes, and launch the national computing power interconnection regional (Hubei) node. At the same time, the conference will coordinate with the National Manufacturing Fund, the Yangtze River Industrial Fund, and the Future Industry (6G) Fund to conduct on-site industry-finance matchmaking and promote the deep integration of technological achievements and capital elements. (Securities Times)
